package testing

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/ready-to-release/eac/src/core/config"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

// NOTE: L-level tags (@L0-@L4) and verification tags (@ov/@iv/@pv/@piv/@ppv) are NEVER inferred.
// These tests verify that inferences are correctly SKIPPED for these tag types.

func TestApplyInferences_LevelTagsNeverInferred(t *testing.T) {
	// Inference rules that try to add level tags should be skipped
	inferences := []Inference{
		{
			TestTypes:   []string{"gotest"},
			IfTags:      []string{},
			ThenAddTags: []string{"@L1"},
			Description: "Go tests default to L1",
		},
	}

	tests := []TestReference{
		{
			FilePath: "service_test.go",
			Type:     "gotest",
			TestName: "TestValidateEmail",
			Tags:     []string{}, // No tags
		},
	}

	result := ApplyInferences(tests, inferences)

	assert.Len(t, result, 1)
	// Level tags should NOT be added - they must be explicit
	assert.NotContains(t, result[0].Tags, "@L1")
}

func TestApplyInferences_VerificationTagsNeverInferred(t *testing.T) {
	// Inference rules that try to add verification tags should be skipped
	inferences := []Inference{
		{
			IfTags:      []string{"@L3"},
			ThenAddTags: []string{"@ov"},
			Description: "Add @ov to L3 tests",
		},
	}

	tests := []TestReference{
		{
			Type:     "godog",
			TestName: "Test scenario",
			Tags:     []string{"@L3"},
		},
	}

	result := ApplyInferences(tests, inferences)

	assert.Len(t, result, 1)
	// Verification tags should NOT be added - they must be explicit
	assert.Contains(t, result[0].Tags, "@L3")
	assert.NotContains(t, result[0].Tags, "@ov")
}

func TestApplyInferences_DependencyInferencesStillWork(t *testing.T) {
	// Dependency inferences (like @deps:go) should still work
	inferences := []Inference{
		{
			TestTypes:   []string{"gotest"},
			IfTags:      []string{},
			ThenAddTags: []string{"@deps:go"},
			Description: "Go tests require go toolchain",
		},
	}

	tests := []TestReference{
		{
			FilePath: "service_test.go",
			Type:     "gotest",
			TestName: "TestValidateEmail",
			Tags:     []string{"@L1", "@ov"},
		},
	}

	result := ApplyInferences(tests, inferences)

	assert.Len(t, result, 1)
	assert.Contains(t, result[0].Tags, "@L1")
	assert.Contains(t, result[0].Tags, "@ov")
	assert.Contains(t, result[0].Tags, "@deps:go")
}

func TestApplyInferences_OnlyAppliesToMatchingTestType(t *testing.T) {
	inferences := []Inference{
		{
			TestTypes:   []string{"godog"},
			IfTags:      []string{},
			ThenAddTags: []string{"@deps:godog"},
			Description: "Godog tests require godog dependency",
		},
	}

	tests := []TestReference{
		{
			Type:     "gotest",
			TestName: "Go test",
			Tags:     []string{"@L1", "@ov"},
		},
	}

	result := ApplyInferences(tests, inferences)

	// Should NOT apply godog inference to gotest
	assert.NotContains(t, result[0].Tags, "@deps:godog")
}

func TestInferSystemDepsFromModuleDeps_GoModule(t *testing.T) {
	// This test requires a mock registry
	// For now, we'll skip it and rely on integration testing
	t.Skip("Requires module registry - use integration testing")
}

func TestHasAnyLevelTag(t *testing.T) {
	assert.True(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{"@L0", "@deps:go"}))
	assert.True(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{"@L1"}))
	assert.True(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{"@L2", "@ov"}))
	assert.True(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{"@L3"}))
	assert.True(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{"@L4"}))
	assert.False(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{"@ov", "@deps:go"}))
	assert.False(t, hasAnyLevelTag([]string{}))
}

func TestInferSystemDepsFromEnv_SkippedInIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip("Requires git repository and config files - covered by integration tests")
}

func TestInferSystemDepsFromEnv_NilContract(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []TestReference{
		{
			Type:     "godog",
			TestName: "Test with nil contract",
			Tags:     []string{"@env:local01"},
		},
	}

	result := InferSystemDepsFromEnv(tests, nil)

	assert.Len(t, result, 1)
	assert.Equal(t, tests[0].Tags, result[0].Tags)
}

func TestInferSystemDepsFromEnv_NoEnvironmentTags(t *testing.T) {
	// Create a minimal env config for testing
	envConfig := &config.EnvironmentsConfig{
		Environments: []config.Environment{
			{
				Moniker:    "test-env",
				SystemDeps: []string{"@deps:docker"},
			},
		},
	}

	tests := []TestReference{
		{
			Type:     "godog",
			TestName: "Test without environment tags",
			Tags:     []string{"@L2", "@ov"},
		},
	}

	result := InferSystemDepsFromEnv(tests, envConfig)

	assert.Len(t, result, 1)
	// Tags should be unchanged since no @env: tag matches
	assert.Equal(t, tests[0].Tags, result[0].Tags)
}
